steps.title: Define Simple Tap Counter Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application configuration settings, setting the name to 'Simple Tap Counter' and the namespace package to 'com.simpletapcounter.app'.

steps.title: Initialize Project Steps Tracking File
steps.description: Formulate a comprehensive step progress mapping definition structure inside build-steps.json to log UI and sound upgrade sequences.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Audio Synthesis Engine
steps.description: Incorporate audio synthesizers in MainActivity.java using the native Android AudioTrack API to generate retro sine-wave chimes, sweeps, and arpeggios dynamically.

steps.title: Incorporate Responsive Tap Pluck Audio Effect
steps.description: Connect high-fidelity synthesized tap plucks with short decaying sound envelopes to provide immediate tactile counters confirmation.

steps.title: Configure High Score Arpeggio Notification Sound
steps.description: Implement a four-note sequential synth chord arpeggio trigger that signals when a user achieves or breaks their high score.

steps.title: Add Reset Sound Frequency Sweep Descent
steps.description: Map a programmatically computed linear frequency sweep downward pitch tone to reset triggers, conveying the clearing action acoustically.

steps.title: Connect Quick Multiplier Button Touch Sound
steps.description: Attach distinctive short higher-octave selections to multiplier step switches to clarify action-state changes clearly.

steps.title: Build Double Tone Notification for Theme Switching
steps.description: Add cascading dual-tone synth chimes matching color changes to enhance aesthetic responsiveness visually and auditorily.

steps.title: Refine Mute Configuration Controls Consistency
steps.description: Polish sound trigger state validation, ensuring that audio generation checks soundEnabled flag correctly before threads run.

steps.title: Building Simple Tap Counter
steps.description: Perform validation and compilation checks on modified layout files to generate final debug packaging successfully.
